One up your brushing

  • The One that cleans better

  • The One for on-the-go

  • The One without hassle

  • The One in multiple colors

Good vibrations

Think of the One like a manual toothbrush that works harder and faster. 13,000 microvibrations per minute and contoured bristles gently clean your teeth for a whiter, brighter smile.

Travel case to take with you wherever whenever

The One is made to travel so you can get that clean feeling any place. It’s sleek and lightweight and fits neatly into a compact travel case.

Routine made easy with brushing guidance

Sometimes, we all need a little guidance. The One buzzes every 30 seconds encouraging you to move on to the next part of your mouth. A longer buzz at 2 minutes lets you know when the job is done.

The Belle of Texas

09/09/2023

US

The best travel toothbrush!!

I've used Philips Sonicare toothbrushes for many years but when it came to travel I always felt the case was more bulkier than I wanted so i opted for smaller off brands. . The ONE has changed that!! It's perfect. The power and cleaning capabilities of the larger ones but with a super slim brush and travel case. You can also charge the toothbrush while it's protected in the case and you can use the same charging cable you use for your phone. I've bought several for gifts as well. Not sure how long they'll last but if it's like my other Philips brushes it will run years and years. My only complaint is all the cool colors only come in the battery operated version ONE and I hate battery operated toothbrushes.

Pros

Portable, compact, powerful , rechargeable

Cons

Not the best color options

Yes, I recommend this product
